RELOCK_ASCENSIONS.SCREEN.title: Ascensions
RELOCK_ASCENSIONS.SCREEN.historyHelp:
[gold]Use Run History[/gold]
Sets every Ascension to the highest level your runs have earned. Ascensions without runs stay where they are.
RELOCK_ASCENSIONS.SCREEN.intro:
Each Ascension starts at what you have unlocked on [gold]{profile}[/gold]. Use the arrows to lower it or raise it, up to the highest level. A character appears here once you have selected it in character select.

Reset puts every row back to what is unlocked; Use Run History sets them to what your runs earned. Nothing is saved until you press Save.
RELOCK_ASCENSIONS.SCREEN.focusRevealsEpo: Raising it also unlocks {scope}'s Ascension and potions on the timeline.
RELOCK_ASCENSIONS.SCREEN.focusBlitzLocke: Unlock {scope} in the game first to raise it.
RELOCK_ASCENSIONS.SCREEN.pending: {count} {count:plural:Ascension changes|Ascensions change} when you press Save.
RELOCK_ASCENSIONS.ROW.revealsEpoch: Also unlocks the Ascension and potions of {characters} on the timeline.
